attempts.text:
The best plan rescues everyone at Kalika temple and Syaphru care home in two round trips, and defers the 2 people who can't be reached. Total cost is 282.

**Unreachable people.** Nilkantha temple and Suryagadhi market connect only to each other. The road from Kalika temple to Nilkantha temple is impassable, so no car can get there. The 1 elderly person (50) and 1 adult (20) must be deferred, for a penalty of 70.

**Routes.**
- Jwalamukhi shelter to Kalika temple goes through Gajuri school: 19 + 19 = 38 min. The direct road from Belkot farm to Kalika temple is impassable.
- Syaphru care home can only be reached through Kalika temple: 38 + 30 = 68 min. Its direct road to the shelter is impassable.

**Why two trips.** There are 7 reachable people (6 elderly and 1 injured) and only 4 seats, so at least two trips are needed.
- **Trip 1:** collect 4 elderly at Kalika temple. This takes 38 + 38 = 76 min.
- **Trip 2:** drive to Syaphru, collect the injured person, then collect the last 2 elderly at Kalika on the way back. This takes 68 + 30 + 38 = 136 min.

Fetching the injured person adds 60 min, which is cheaper than deferring them (80). Making the second trip at all saves money too. Skipping it would mean deferring 2 elderly plus the injured person, a penalty of 180 instead of 136 min of driving.

<plan>
defer nilkantha-temple elderly 1
defer suryagadhi-market adult 1
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school kalika-temple
drive car1 kalika-temple syaphru-care-home
load car1 injured 1
drive car1 syaphru-care-home kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 kalika-temple gajuri-school
drive car1 gajuri-school jwalamukhi-shelter
unload car1 injured 1
unload car1 elderly 2
</plan>

**Cost.** Driving is 76 + 136 = 212 min. Adding the 70 penalty for the 2 deferred people gives 282.

COST: 282
